entries.title: @brunocordista @kimmonismus To run GLM-5.3 locally you need serious multi-GPU hardware.
entries.body: @brunocordista @kimmonismus To run GLM-5.3 locally you need serious multi-GPU hardware. It is a ~753B MoE model (~40B active). Even 2-bit quant needs ~240 GB VRAM, Q4 around 386 GB, FP8 ~750 GB, full BF16 ~1.5 TB. Practical floor is something like 8x H200. Consumer GPUs or single cards will not work.
